_help.about: Personal settings of this player. They are also changed in game: companion overview (J) > HUD & Theme.
_help.theme: Color theme of the menus: blue, red, green, purple, amber or slate.
_help.hudVisible: true shows the companion HUD on screen, false hides it.
_help.hudAnchor: Screen position the HUD sticks to: TOP_LEFT, TOP_CENTER, TOP_RIGHT, LEFT, RIGHT, BOTTOM_LEFT, BOTTOM_CENTER or BOTTOM_RIGHT.
_help.hudOffsetX: Moves the HUD sideways from its anchor, in GUI pixels. Range: -1000 to 1000.
_help.hudOffsetY: Moves the HUD up or down from its anchor, in GUI pixels. Range: -1000 to 1000.
_help.hudStyle: FULL: card with portrait, level, XP and health. COMPACT: slim bar per companion. ICONS: small portrait tile per companion.
_help.hudFrame: Frame around each entry: ORNATE (silver/obsidian like the menus), SIMPLE (thin line) or NONE.
_help.hudDirection: VERTICAL stacks companions top to bottom, HORIZONTAL puts them side by side.
_help.hudScale: Size of the HUD in percent. Range: 50 to 200.
_help.hudOpacity: Opacity of the frame and background in percent; text and bars stay solid. Range: 0 to 100.
_help.hudSpacing: Gap between two companions in GUI pixels. Range: 0 to 20.
_help.hudMaxShown: Most companions shown at once. Range: 1 to 10.
_help.hudShowAll: true shows every companion that is out in the world, false only the selected one.
_help.hudShowPortrait: true shows the companion's model (FULL and COMPACT; ICONS always show it).
_help.hudShowXp: true shows the XP bar (FULL style only).
_help.hudShowNumbers: true writes the values under the bars, e.g. 18 / 20.
_help.hudShowStatus: true shows bleeding, infection and downed icons.
_help.hudTheme: Color theme of the HUD: menu (same as the menus), blue, red, green, purple, amber or slate.
_help.hudAccentColor: Custom accent color as #RRGGBB, empty for the theme color. Same for hudHealthColor, hudXpColor and hudNameColor.
